condition.narrative: Consistent with the Article III of the SBAA [or the Supplemental Provisions to the Project Document], the responsibility for the safety and security of the Implementing Partner and its personnel and property, and of UNDP’s property in the Implementing Partner’s custody, rests with the Implementing Partner. To this end, the Implementing Partner shall: a) put in place an appropriate security plan and maintain the security plan, taking into account the security situation in the country where the project is being carried; b) assume all risks and liabilities related to the Implementing Partner’s security, and the full implementation of the security plan.

Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

1: Approximately USD 4,112,515 have been leveraged for climate related innovative projects 2: The project’s initiatives have reached approximately 690,000 beneficiaries out of which 60% are women 3: The (sub)projects initiated in 2020 by the Green City Project will cumulatively lead to 14.82 kilotons CO2eq reduction calculated over 20 years 4: 4 companies were selected as founders of GCL: Premier Energy Ltd, Simpals Ltd, ABS Ltd, AM Sisteme ltd. 5: 9 formal partnership agreements were signed 6: A non-GEF Cost sharing agreement was concluded with the Energy Efficiency Fund in the amount of USD 118,000. 7: Green City Action Plan was approved by the Chisinau Municipal Council, and the Green Design Code was developed. In support of the Sustainable Urban Mobility Plan development were performed: • GIS dashboard and database for urban data visualization (accessibility to public transport, energy consumption, population distribution) developed in partnership with MiLab • Street design code was approved by the Municipal Council • Smart traffic strategy and Action Plan is under implementation (until April 2021) which comes in support of SUMP development. • Dedicated bus lanes • Action plans for further expansion of the dedicated bus lanes network in Chisinau was developed. • Traffic measurement equipment procured in order to provide services to Municipality and other customers for traffic data collection • 31 August 1989 street redesign by developing technical project according to the Street design guide developed by GCL in 2019. 8: 2 demo projects are under implementation or have been initiated 9: 7 projects were implemented, and other 5 selected for support 10: 17 buildings selected with Chisinau Municipality in order to pilot EMIS. Additional 23 public buildings (part of EBRD project) will be connected to the platform. Smart meters for EMIS piloting were procured. Concentrator procurement is in the evaluation stage. 11: citizen engagement platform www.eu.chisinau.md is fully operational since January 2020. 12: Project activities will be replicated in the region. Ongoing project activities (ex. EMIS) and other technical solutions are planned to be included in the EU-UNDP Focal-regions project targeting 2 municipalities, based on the discussion between project teams. Moreover, there is interest from Tajikistan for replicating the Green city project successful experience related to Electric vehicles charging stations.

1: The project cumulatively initiated or supported additional founds attraction of USD 17.45 million as investments related to climate action 2: Supplementary to the beneficiaries of activities implemented in Chisinau, about 690 thousand of which 60% are women, in 2022 the project extended its activity in 3 new locations: Balti municipality, Singerei district and Sculeni village, Ungheni district, implementing demonstrative projects that reached about 10 thousand direct beneficiaries, of which 70% are women. 3: The (sub)projects co-financed so far by the Green City Project will cumulatively lead to at least 1500 kilotons CO2eq. reduction calculated over a 20 year 4: Green City Lab Moldova is fully operational and its extending it’s activity in other locations that Chisinau. At the end of 2022, GCL has 7 permanent employees and other consultants/specialist are hired according to the needs. 5: At least 15 formal co-operation agreements were signed so far. 6: Additional contracts/agreements to cover GCL operational costs were signed with Soros Moldova Foundation, UNDP/Polish Challenge Fund, Czech Embassy, FTA/USAID, Embassy of Netherlands/ Expert Grup 7: Chisinau streets renovations are initiated by Chisinau municipality according to the recommendations of the Strategy and Action Plan for Intelligent Transport System and Green Guide for Street Design, developed with the support of the Green Cities Projects. At the same time, dedicated lanes for public transport are tested in Chisinau according to recommendations developed under the Project. 8: 4 demo projects were initiated 9: 6 projects were successfully implemented in Chisinau, Balti, Singerei and Sculeni, Ungheni 10: 17 public institutions from Chisinau were connected to EMIS, and employees benefited from energy management training courses and support. Additionally, all public institutions from Tru?eni, Sire?i, and Cantemir have been connected Energy Management Information System based on energy management services contract with GCL. 11: Green City Project was involved in organization of 2 relevant events: two-days training for energy managers from Moldova on energy efficiency for public and private buildings, organizes in partnership with Energy Efficiency Agency and UNECE Geneva, as well as Environmental Day 2022. 12: Green City Project initiatives are replicated in Balti, Ungheni, Singerei, Cahul, Ungheni, and other locations from Moldova. At the same time, experience related to Electric vehicles charging stations was shared with UNDP Ecuador.

description.narrative: End of project target - At least 5 or more signed non-GEF funded contracts or agreements at the combined value of at least USD 500,000 to enable GCL to continue its financially sustainable operation after the end of the project. The GCL shall have a target of annual revenues of $200,000 per annum by the end of the project, not including fees that are earned from the project itself. This should be broken down into the GCL having at least 5 clients who pay at least $40,000 USD per annum each.

title.narrative: Status of the GCL and the specific outputs under Outcome 1 to support its operations

description.narrative: End of project target - The GCL established as a self- standing public or semi-public institution with all the outputs of the attached work plan under Outcome 1 completed. The GCL must be able to continue operations and to grow as it has alternative sources of revenue outside of the project and it should have at least 5 clients, each generating revenues of $40,000 per annum or more meaning that the GCL should have revenues of at least $200,000 per annum by the end of the project.
